---
title: "plot_diff_app"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2, here, bayesplot)

# Load in data 
file_name = "N20_cent_noncent.rds"
fits = readRDS(here("fits", file_name))

# Define approaches 
app_1 = "centered"
app_2 = "non-centered"

#Simulations
sim = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sim_units, .id= "run") %>%  mutate(run = as.numeric(run))
sim_sigma = sim %>% select(run, t_sigma) %>% group_by(run) %>% distinct()

# Diagnostics
dia_app1 = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$dia_C, .id = "run") %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% group_by(run) %>% summarise(sum_div = sum(divergent__), div = ifelse(sum(divergent__)>0,1,0), max_t = ifelse(any(treedepth__>=10), 1,0)) %>% mutate(app = app_1) %>% left_join(sim_sigma, by = "run")

dia_app2 = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$dia_nonC, .id = "run") %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% group_by(run) %>% summarise(sum_div = sum(divergent__), div = ifelse(sum(divergent__)>0,1,0), max_t = ifelse(any(treedepth__>=10), 1,0)) %>% mutate(app = app_2)%>% left_join(sim_sigma, by = "run")

dia = bind_rows(dia_app1, dia_app2)
```

```{r}
######################
## Plot divergences ##
######################

# plot
plot = ggplot(dia)+
  stat_summary(aes(x=as.factor(t_sigma), y = div), fun = "mean", geom = "bar",stat = 'identity', col = 'black', linewidth = 1.2, fill = "lightgreen")+
  labs(x="t_sigma", y = "prop. divergent runs", title = "proportion of divergent runs over # units")+
  theme_classic()+ theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+facet_wrap(~app)

print(plot)
```
```{r}
#############################
## Plot parameter recovery ##
#############################

# Extract simulated parameters in a long format
sim_param = sim %>% select(t_sigma, t_mu, unit, run, U, t_mu_mu, t_mu_sigma) %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% group_by(run) %>%  distinct() %>% ungroup() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = unit,values_from = c(t_mu),names_glue = "{.value}[{unit}]") %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(t_sigma, starts_with("t_mu")), names_to = "variable",values_to = "value") %>% rename("sim" = "value") 

# Extract summary 
summary_app1 = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sum_C, .id = 'run') %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% filter(str_detect(variable, "t_mu\\[") | variable == "t_sigma"|variable =="t_mu_mu"|variable =="t_mu_sigma") %>% left_join(sim_param, by = c("run", "variable")) %>% left_join(dia_app1, by = c("run"))

summary_app2 = map_dfr(fits, ~.x$sum_nonC, .id = 'run') %>% mutate(run = as.numeric(run)) %>% filter(str_detect(variable, "t_mu\\[") | variable == "t_sigma"|variable =="t_mu_mu"|variable =="t_mu_sigma") %>% left_join(sim_param, by = c("run", "variable")) %>% left_join(dia_app2, by = c("run"))

summary = bind_rows(summary_app1, summary_app2)

plot_app1 = ggplot(summary %>% filter(app == app_1))+geom_point(aes(x=sim, y = mean, col = as.factor(div)))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=sim, ymin = q5, ymax = q95, col = as.factor(div)))+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope =1, linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_classic()+facet_wrap(~variable, scales = 'free')+labs(title = app_1)

plot_app2 = ggplot(summary %>% filter(app == app_2))+geom_point(aes(x=sim, y = mean, col = as.factor(div)))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=sim, ymin = q5, ymax = q95, col = as.factor(div)))+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope =1, linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_classic()+facet_wrap(~variable, scales = 'free')+labs(title = app_2)
```

vars = c("t_mu_mu", "t_mu_sigma_log", "t_sigma_mu_log", "t_sigma_sigma_log", "t_mu[1]", "t_mu[2]", "t_sigma_log[1]", "t_sigma_log[2]")
run = 5

np = as_tibble(fits[[run]][["dia_C"]]) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(.chain, .iteration, .draw), 
    names_to = "Parameter",values_to = "Value") %>%rename(Chain = .chain, Iteration = .iteration) %>% 
  select(Parameter, Iteration, Chain, Value) %>% mutate(Parameter= factor(Parameter))


mcmc_pairs(fits[[run]][['draws_C']], pars = vars, np = np)
